title: The Old Man Fed the Birds Every Morning

scenes.narration: Every morning, an old man sat on the same bench and fed the birds.
Rain or shine. Always the same crumbs. Always the same seat.
The whole neighborhood assumed he was just lonely.
Children laughed, joggers passed. He only smiled and scattered the bread.
One day, a young woman asked why he never missed a single morning.
He gently patted the empty half of the bench.
My wife fed them here for forty years, he said.
She knew every one of them. Named them. They came to her like old friends.
When she passed, the birds still came. Looking for her.
So I come. So they're not waiting for someone who'll never return.
The woman sat with him in silence. The birds gathered around them both.
He wasn't feeding birds. He was keeping a promise.
Some love doesn't end. It just changes who it takes care of.
Who do you show up for, even when no one is watching? Tell me below.
